cars.generation: Original 1987–1989 Shadow-based Shelby CSX road family
cars.variant: CSX-VNT — 1989 period-tested manual, optional wider tyres and Recaro seats
cars.specification_market: 1989 Shelby CSX-VNT, selected May 1989 Motor Trend road-test configuration with five-speed manual, optional wider 225/50VR15 tyres and optional Recaro seats. Count the original 1987–1989 Dodge Shadow/Plymouth Sundance-based CSX road family once across years and packages. Not the separate Omni GLHS, Cobra CSX chassis numbers, CSX-T rental specification, birthday prototype or later engine swap. The test body and table disagree on torque peak, so torque and its speed remain unassigned. No universal first-VNT or first-composite-wheel claim, production total, test acceleration or top speed is adopted.
cars.summary: The Shelby CSX brought unusual turbocharger and lightweight-wheel engineering to the American front-drive performance hatch. The contemporary Motor Trend road test documents its variable-nozzle turbo, composite wheels and sharp handling, alongside noise, torque steer and brake-fade limitations. The 1989 VNT represents the original CSX road programme once, rather than supplying separate entries for its model years.

sources.publisher: Motor Trend / public scan hosted by Triggerscarstuff on Flickr
sources.title: Shelby CSX — Mr. Shelby’s wild ride, Jeff Karr, May 1989, pages 162–166
sources.source_type: Original contemporary first-hand road test, hosted scan
sources.notes: All four scan images visually read: https://www.flickr.com/photos/triggerscarstuff/6462346845/ (162–163), https://www.flickr.com/photos/triggerscarstuff/6462346923/ (164), https://www.flickr.com/photos/triggerscarstuff/6462346953/ (165), https://www.flickr.com/photos/triggerscarstuff/6462346967/ (166). Selected reference is the tested car with optional Recaro seats and wider tyres. Body gives 200 lb-ft at 2400 rpm while table appears to give 200 at 3400; no torque field imported. Power is consistently 175 hp SAE net at 5200 rpm. Getrag brand is stated in body; no unverified gearbox model number. No test images are distributed as vehicle photographs.

sources.notes: Cover scan visually read; linked text transcriptions 1989csx-ownersmanual-2.html through -6.html read in full. Gross vehicle weight is not curb weight; no maintenance advice imported. Registry summary and inaccessible unique-parts PDF do not override the period test.

attributes.label: Configuration
attributes.value: Inline four-cylinder; SOHC, two valves per cylinder

attributes.label: Induction
attributes.value: Intercooled Garrett variable-nozzle turbo; moveable vanes, no wastegate

attributes.label: Selected gearbox
attributes.value: Getrag five-speed manual; model number not assigned

attributes.label: Front architecture
attributes.value: Independent struts, single lower control arms, coil springs and anti-roll bar

attributes.label: Rear architecture
attributes.value: Beam axle with Panhard rod, coil springs and gas-filled dampers

attributes.label: ABS
attributes.value: Not available in the period test specification

attributes.label: Period test wheels
attributes.value: 15 x 6.5-inch fiberglass composite; Motor Wheel Corporation
